name: sumire-workout-tracker
description: Blue Archive Sumire-themed workout tracker — unofficial, non-commercial fan project

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
